posts.body_html:
Here's a selection that I originally got from Brooks Garcia of Sarracenia obsessed www.sarraceniaobsessed.com/ This clone has a very strange arching lid, and can turn dark purple to almost black under optimal conditions. The traps can grow extremely tall, perhaps more than 3 ft! When I first received the plant, the trap was jaw-dropping in terms of height...almost unbelievable. It is now producing relatively tall pitchers, although not as tall as when I originally received it. Perhaps it needs more time to acclimate.
